rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken form for asking which person's thing or things they are, including when the possessed noun is omitted.

example.english: Do you know whose umbrella this is?
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 ze1 hai6 bin1 go3 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for asking which person owns something, including before the possessed noun.

example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 ze1 hai6 bin1 go3 ge3

rows.note: Use this relative-clause restructuring when B, the possessor's noun, is involved in the clause V; for example, 隻狗搞出意外嗰個男人 means “the man whose dog caused the accident.”

example.english: I saw the man whose dog bit someone.
example.traditional: 我見過隻狗咬親人嗰個男人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 gwo3 zek3 gau2 ngaau5 can1 jan4 go2 go3 naam4 jan4
